newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard Air revises two fare promotions.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Air revises two fare promotions.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said Thursday it will offer its lowest fares with a requirement of a single-day advance purchase.
The carrier said tickets must be purchased between February 20 and March 4. The lowest fares were previously available with a seven-day advance purchase, Vanguard said.

Vanguard is also extending its "Half-Price for Half-Pints" promotion that offers 50-percent fare discounts to children and seniors though March 4. The discount program, which applies to all fares, was originally scheduled to end February 28, Vanguard said.
Vanguard offers passenger flights to 15 cities.
